reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 4.5 Acting/Cast 4.5 Music 3.5 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers The plot was disjointed I watched this on Song Yujia marathon drama last year and found out she collaborated with Wang Dao Tie..It's really hard to give a review. I can't say it's good, and I can't say it's bad. The premises was quite good but this drama feel disjointed about ML backstory and FL backstory seems not to be match. Surprisingly, I found Wang Daotie to be much better in the drama. He looks younger in here. From the ML perspective, FL is too saintly. She always tries to run away, betrays ML's love, and even causes the death of ML's sister. In fact, because of FL's series of actions, you can empathize with the ML and feel sorry for him. But ML is real villain. He's not an undercover agent; he's the head of a criminal organization leader. So, it's not wrong for FL to try everything to escape. ML runs human trafficking organization and FL happened to check on the case. It was quite unfortunate case in this drama. They used to much darker filter in this drama and it's not looking good. reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Gothic fantasy about blood, magic elixir and true love I discovered this drama when I was doing a reddit assignment on Xie Yu Wang. Darn, both Xie Yu Wang and Han Jia Hui are my favourites so I was excited about this drama. I watched it last night and wow, I was surprised.What I liked:1. Fantasy - I never thought this could be a fantasy drama - I liked the fantasy element a lot. Magic blood and its healing properties. Experimentation for an elixir.2. Romance - Yes, finally a ML having a spring dream. That dream was spicy and it made sense why he had that dream. They had a rocky relationship with their circumstance going against them but I enjoyed their love story. 3. ML characterisation - I liked that ML got curious about FL and figured out her secret in the first act. Then he offered a partnership deal to FL. He too had a mission to accomplish.4. FL characterisation - She's a complex character. She had to put on a mask to save herself from being exploited. In third act, she was conflicted between revenge and love. Good character growth.5. Acting - It's good to see Han Jia Hui in a dramatic role - she challenged herself. Xie Yu Wang played his role well too. I liked the chemistry between them - there was a tacit understanding and strong sexual tension between them.6. Styling - Great outfits worn by ML. I liked most outfits worn by FL except the first dress. The red stains looked like blood and the colour tone - hhhhmm it wasn't a pretty dress to me.What I disliked:1. Abuse - I pitied FL for the abuse she had to endure. I hated that the kids were part of the experiment.2. Antagonists - FL's father was evil. Já Qing Qian, sua infância em um lar com violência doméstica e alcoolismo, a fez jogar o jogo dos ricos, a usar as pessoas, e pelas ações do psicopata do 2ML, se manteve ao lado, mas não era boba. reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.5 Rewatch Value 7.5 ? YEARS OF UNSPOKEN LOVE OVERALL IMPRESSION🌟This was a deeply emotional romance about two people who had secretly loved each other for years, yet remained separated by pride, insecurity, age and social status. Although the story contains intense attraction, jealousy and possessiveness, its emotional centre is Shen Qing Li’s struggle to maintain her dignity and independence while carrying the enormous responsibility of paying for her seriously ill brother’s treatment.WHAT I LIKED💖• As expected, Min Jie was not shy about displaying his beautiful eight-pack, and the drama also delivered plenty of passionate kissing!• Shen Qing Li was poor, young and somewhat naive, but she was never greedy. She showed little interest in expensive gifts or luxury because her priority was earning money for her brother’s medical expenses.• I admired her determination to work for what she needed. Her emotional distance was not indifference; it was her way of protecting her pride, independence and vulnerable heart.• She had quietly loved Gu Heng for years and hoped to reach his social level before pursuing him. After circumstances forced her into a humiliating arrangement with him, she feared that he would never respect her, love her sincerely or consider her his equal.• Gu Heng was extremely difficult to read. He appeared cold and disinterested, yet he was always the first to protect her, pay her debts and create excuses to see her again.• His devotion emerged through actions rather than words. He became increasingly jealous and possessive because he had also loved her for years but was emotionally guarded and terrified of losing her.• I enjoyed their central contradiction: she withdrew because she believed she could never belong in his world, while he held on too tightly because he feared she would disappear from it.WHAT I DISLIKED⚠️• The SML was horribly manipulative. He secretly interfered with the FL’s employment and education to make her dependent on him, while allowing her to believe that Gu Heng was responsible for her suffering.• His behaviour became completely unforgivable when, after feeling rejected, he sold the FL into human trafficking. Whatever sympathy his feelings might once have inspired disappeared at that point.• Gu Heng’s inability to communicate made his genuine devotion appear controlling. Instead of explaining his feelings, he relied on jealousy, possessiveness and forceful actions, which intensified the FL’s fear that he did not respect her.• The ending did not feel quite right. I would have preferred Shen Qing Li to confess while sober so that her decision felt completely deliberate and emotionally satisfying.• Several conflicts and misunderstandings still needed proper resolution, making the final scenes feel abrupt rather than complete.PRODUCTION AND PERFORMANCES🎭• Min Jie effectively balanced Gu Heng’s cold, intimidating exterior with the vulnerability of a man who had secretly loved the FL for years. His protectiveness, jealousy and fear of losing her were visible even when the character refused to communicate.• Liu Xiao Yu gave Shen Qing Li a convincing mixture of pride, resilience, innocence and emotional vulnerability. Her performance helped explain why the FL repeatedly pulled away despite loving him.• The drama’s strongest element was not the external conflict but the emotional difference between how the leads felt and how their behaviour was interpreted. Their love was mutual, yet neither believed it could be safely expressed.FINAL THOUGHTS💭I think this drama is ultimately more about the FL’s independence and personal struggles than a simple “who did what to whom” story. That focus may explain why the ending felt so abrupt: Shen Qing Li’s emotional growth was treated as the destination, even though several relationship issues still needed resolving. I would have preferred a sober confession and a little more time for the leads to discuss their years of misunderstanding. Nevertheless, their shared history transformed the romance into a moving story of mutual secret devotion—she believed she was unworthy of his world, while he had been quietly waiting for her all along. synopsis: The story is about Chinese students at the prestigious Ivy League college. The efforts they made to get accepted, when just being gifted students isn't enough; their experiences, struggles, relationships, and the blend of Chinese-Western cultures while studying there. Gu Nian planned to study abroad because she wanted to be with her foreign boyfriend for a long time. Without any experience in studying abroad, she enrolled in a studying abroad agency, LZ, on the net but had a dispute with the company's owner, Lin Yao, and her boyfriend, Zhuo Peng. The reason was that Lin Yao took Gu Nian's order even though the company was short of staff. Zhuo Peng, who was a legal entity but did not work in the company, was forced to become Gu Nian's temporary tutor and helped her become a university student. Shortly afterwards, Lin Yao and Zhuo Peng broke up. Zhuo Peng was hired as a psychological counselor at the University of A. He found that the international student community has some psychological, life, and academic problems due to the uncomfortable environment. That's why Zhuo Peng set up a free consultancy service to help students find the right school for them. This goal also coincided with Gu Nian's. In the end, they became partners and a couple. reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 Apologize for a lie This drama begins with one betrayal after another, and I really felt for Lin Qing Hui. She grows up believing she is the treasured daughter of the Lin family, only to discover at thirteen that she isn't their biological child. Once Lin Wan Wan returns, Qing Hui slowly loses the family, love, and life she once knew.But what happened when she was eighteen was unforgivable.Lin Wan Wan pushes the Fu family's heiress down the stairs and then frames Qing Hui. Instead of someone finally standing beside her, even her childhood sweetheart Lu Chen betrays her. The man who once knew and cared about her chooses power and status, then goes even further by giving false testimony in court that sends an innocent Qing Hui to **prison for ten years**.For me, that is where Lu Chen crosses a line that regret alone cannot erase. This wasn't simply a misunderstanding or him failing to believe her. He actively participated in destroying her life.Qing Hui loses her freedom and ten years she can never get back because the people around her chose themselves over the truth. That makes her character especially compelling because after everything taken from her, I wanted to see what kind of woman would eventually walk out of that prison.You can apologize for a lie. You can regret choosing the wrong person. But how do you give someone back ten stolen years of their life? 💔This story definitely made me want to see Qing Hui reclaim everything that was taken from her.
